asked.item: Custom thumbnail via thumbnailUrl never applies
Channel verified, good standing, image meets specs

verdict.reason: The FAQ gives a separate cause, an account connected before verification or before thumbnail support, and says to re-connect.

steps.text: If you connected your YouTube account before custom thumbnail support was added, or you verified your account after first connecting it to Blotato, you'll need to re-connect your account.
To re-connect, go to Settings, then click "Connect account > YouTube" or click the "Reconnect" button on your YouTube account.
